articles.title: Saudi-led coalition says new attack at Riyadh airport causes fire, day after strike kills 12
articles.description: The Saudi-led coalition in Yemen said an "unidentified projectile" had targeted Riyadh's international airport on Sunday, causing a fire. The incident came hours after the Iran-backed Houthis warned airlines and travellers to stay away from Saudi airports. David Smith, The Guardian's Washington bureau chief, tells us more.

related.title: Saudi Arabia threatens 'decisive' response after Riyadh airport strike kills at least 12

articles.title: Trump's energy ceasefire announcement was 'news for me' (Zelensky)
articles.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky told the Axios digital news outlet on Sunday that he was surprised by US counterpart Donald Trump's announcement of a Ukraine-Russia "energy ceasefire," but he would accept it whenever it begins. Our correspondent Gulliver Cragg tells us more.

articles.title: India's 'cockroach' leaders vow to keep up election protests
articles.description: Leaders of India's online "cockroach" movement pledged on Sunday to continue their campaign against the election commissioner, hours after they were released from detention as authorities sought to thwart a major demonstration. Our correspondent Navodita Kumari tells us more.

articles.title: Ukraine says ready to halt refinery strikes if Moscow stops energy attacks
articles.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky on Sunday said Kyiv was ready to halt strikes Russian oil refineries if Moscow stopped attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure. Zelensky also pushed back on US President Donald Trump's comments made Saturday evening calling for Ukraine to elect a new leader by saying, "It's up to our people".

articles.title: Risque d’ingérence, candidats potentiels… En Ukraine, une élection présidentielle en temps de guerre est-elle possible ?
articles.description: La loi martiale exclut tout scrutin en temps de guerre. Au-delà de l’obstacle constitutionnel, 70 % des Ukrainiens rejettent l’idée d’une élection avant la cessation des combats, conscients de la difficulté de faire voter un pays morcelé entre soldats sur le front, civils sous le feu de l’artillerie russe et diaspora dispersée.

articles.title: "C'est à notre peuple qu'il revient de choisir" son président, répond Volodymyr Zelensky à Donald Trump
articles.description: Le président américain avait estimé qu'il était temps pour l'Ukraine d'avoir un nouveau président afin de "parvenir à un accord avec la Russie".

articles.title: Le pape Léon XIV annonce qu'il va être opéré d'un nodule au poumon "dans les prochains jours"
articles.description: Le souverain pontife, âgé de 71 ans, a annoncé cette prochaine intervention à l'issue d'une prière publique au Vatican. Le nodule a été "détecté à un stade précoce", a-t-il rassuré.

articles.title: The week in pictures: French student protests, October 7 anniversary and Adenot's return to Earth
articles.description: Blockades and protests by French secondary school and university students continued, occasionally becoming violent; French astronaut Sophie Adenot returned to Earth after eight months aboard the International Space Station; Israel's commemorations marking the three-year anniversary of the October 7 attacks: here's a look back at some of the most striking images from the past week's news.

articles.title: Brazil's Lula accuses social media giant Meta of election interference amid tight run-off campaign
articles.description: Social media platform Meta has 48 hours to respond to claims by Brazil's leftwing candidate and incumbent President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's campaign accusing the tech platform of blocking content on the company's platforms. Brazil's Superior Electoral Court on Saturday gave the social media giant 48 hours to clarify whether it reduced the reach of posts by Lula's campaign ahead of the tight October 25 run-off against rightwing candidate Flavio Bolsonaro.
